subject: Re: Tiered commit top-up & packaging for adding analytics microservice
messages:
From: Samantha Liu <samantha@brightscale.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Ramos <carlos@brightscale.ai>
Date: 2027-04-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pricing for adding analytics microservice to existing commit

Hi Evelyn,

Quick note from our side — we want to add an internal analytics microservice that will use Redwood hosted API for embeddings + short-context generation. We already have an existing monthly commit with you (current baseline ~1.2B tokens/month). The new workload is estimated at an additional 180–350M tokens/month depending on adoption.

Questions:
- How do you handle incremental top-ups to an existing commit? Is it a blended per-token price or a separate bucket?
- What discount tiers do you typically apply for adding new products / teams under the same account?
- If we commit to an extra 12 months for the analytics workload (minimum 240M tokens/mo), what concession can we expect?

Procurement (Carlos) will need a simple packing + invoice timeline to review. We're aiming to have commercial terms sorted by the end of May.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if easier.

Best,
Samantha
Head of Product, BrightScale AI
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Liu <samantha@brightscale.ai>
Date: 2027-04-28T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing for adding analytics microservice to existing commit

Samantha — thanks for the clear ask. High level: we support both top-up (add-on) commits and blended pricing; the right approach depends on how long you expect the new workload to run and whether you want a single invoice/PO or separate buckets for chargeback.

Quick answers now:
- Short term (<3 months proof-of-concept): recommend a separate add-on with a modest tiered discount (typically 7–10% off list per-token for small short-term top-ups).
- Multi-quarter (6–12 months) commit: blended pricing is feasible — we can create a single committed token pool that covers both products and offer deeper discounts starting at ~12–15% for a 12-month incremental commit sized at ~240M tokens/mo.
- If you want to lock a steady-state larger commit (>=400M extra tokens/mo), we can propose 18–22% off list with a committed capacity SLA.

I'll pull together a short spreadsheet with a couple of sizing/price permutations and loop in our pricing & legal for contract language. Expect a proposal by EOD Thursday.

—Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-29T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Pricing for adding analytics microservice to existing commit

Folks — forwarding BrightScale's ask (below). Key points: they have ~1.2B/mo committed today and want to add 180–350M/mo; target decision end of May. Procurement (Carlos) will need invoice timeline.

Proposed commercial approach (my thinking):
- Option A (12-month incremental commit): +240M/mo blended into a single commit; offer 15% off current list per-token for the incremental tranche; include 2-week ramp clause and monthly usage true-up.
- Option B (shorter add-on): 6-month add-on as a separate bucket at 10% off list; easier to bill separately and less legal churn.
- Option C (aggressive expansion): if they commit to >=400M/mo for 12 months, offer 20% off + priority capacity (dedicated pool during business hours).

Numbers to validate: current list per-token we use for sales decks is $0.00045 for generation and $0.00012 for embeddings (we can use blended token assumptions). For proposal I'll create a simple blended rate.

Laura — for Option A, we should be able to use our standard incremental-commit SOW. Any redlines we should expect around termination or true-up?

Ben/Marcus — can you sanity-check discount bands and whether we want to attach a usage ramp milestone? I attached a quick spreadsheet template (topup_pricing_sheet.xlsx) with a couple of scenarios.

Thanks,
Evelyn

> Quick note from our side — we want to add an internal analytics microservice that will use Redwood hosted API...
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-29T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Pricing for adding analytics microservice to existing commit

Evelyn — quick thoughts after looking at the sheet:
- Discount bands look reasonable. Recommend tightening Option A to 14% (not 15%) for the first 12 months and add a performance step-up to 17% if they hit 400M+ for two consecutive months within the term. That gives room to upsell later.
- Keep Option B (6-month add-on) at 9–10% but include an auto-convert clause: if usage >250M for 3 months, automatically convert to a 12-month blended commit at the agreed uplift.
- For embeddings-heavy workloads, ensure we show blended embedding/generation assumptions explicitly — procurement will ask.

Also suggest a 30-day invoice lead time and include an explicit early-exit true-up table in the SOW (simple arithmetic examples).

Ben

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Liu <samantha@brightscale.ai>, Carlos Ramos <carlos@brightscale.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-02T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Tiered commit top-up & packaging for adding analytics microservice

Samantha / Carlos — attaching a formal proposal for the analytics workload (DF-78321-commit-proposal.pdf). Summary below.

Proposal summary (two recommended paths):

1) 12-month incremental blended commit (Recommended)
- Extra committed tokens: 240M tokens / month for 12 months
- Blended per-token rate: $0.000378 (equivalent to ~15.9% off our current list on blended assumptions)
- Ramp: first 2 months permitted at 50% of the committed level; monthly true-up thereafter
- SLA: standard hosted API SLA; priority routing not included at this level
- Billing: single monthly invoice; 30-day payment terms

2) 12-month + priority (Growth)
- Extra committed tokens: 400M tokens / month for 12 months
- Blended per-token rate: $0.00036 (≈20% off list)
- Includes priority capacity during business hours and a 2% service credit for sustained latency breaches
- Billing & contract: single invoice; 30-day terms; requires SOW addendum for priority pool

Shorter option (6-month add-on) is also in the attached if you want a lower-commitment path — add-on priced at $0.000405 per blended token (≈10% off list) and will auto-convert to a 12-month blended commit if usage >250M for 3 consecutive months.

Next steps:
- If this aligns, sign the attached proposal (DocuSign link included in the PDF) or tell me which option you prefer and I’ll issue a PO-ready quote.
- Laura is cc'd for any contracting redlines; Ben can confirm final billing language.

Attachments: DF-78321-commit-proposal.pdf (proposal + pricing sheet)

Happy to hop on a call Friday to walk through the numbers.

—Evelyn
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
